title: SDLC Objective Reference v1
description: A task-local, task-qualified, or globally qualified reference to an SDLC objective using the repository's #objective/OBJ-* selector convention.
$comment: OBJ identifiers name objectives; the objective selector is always objective, not outcome or criterion. The host must resolve the selected objective and verify that it exists in the declared relationship boundary.

oneOf.description: A reference to an objective declared in the current task payload.
A reference to an objective declared by another task in the same or an authorized work item.
A globally qualified repository reference to an objective.
